# uup_notification_rule (Resource)

A Notification rule: which events go to which Channels. A rule reaches no Monitor until it is assigned to one, with `rule_ids` on `uup_monitor`.

Channels are added and verified in the dashboard. Look one up with the `uup_channel` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uup_project" "main" {
  name = "My project"
}

data "uup_channel" "oncall" {
  project_id = data.uup_project.main.id
  name       = "On-call Slack"
}

resource "uup_notification_rule" "outages" {
  project_id  = data.uup_project.main.id
  name        = "Outages to on-call"
  event_types = ["uptime.failed", "uptime.recovered"]
  channel_ids = [data.uup_channel.oncall.id]
  repeat      = "30m"
}

# Assign the rule to a Monitor.
resource "uup_monitor" "api" {
  project_id   = data.uup_project.main.id
  type         = "http"
  name         = "API"
  url          = "https://api.example.com/health"
  interval_sec = 60
  rule_ids     = [uup_notification_rule.outages.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_ids` (Set of String) The Channels it sends to, `chn_…`.
- `name` (String) The rule's name, unique in the Project.
- `project_id` (String) The Project the rule belongs to, `prj_…`. Changing it makes a new rule.

### Optional

- `event_types` (Set of String) The events it sends. Leave it out to send every event, those added later included. One of: `uptime.failed`, `uptime.recovered`, `certificate.failed`, `certificate.recovered`, `domain.failed`, `domain.recovered`, `certificate.expiring`, `domain.expiring`, `domain.unreadable`, `performance.degraded`, `uptime.family_failing`, `uptime.regional_outage`.
- `repeat` (String) How often an open Incident is sent again: `off`, `30m`, `1h`, `3h` or `6h`. Defaults to `1h`.
- `warnings_during_outage` (Boolean) Whether warnings are sent while an outage is open. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule's identifier, `rul_…`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the Project's Default rule. The Default rule is made with the Project and cannot be deleted, so it can be imported and changed but not created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A rule is imported as <project_id>/<rule_id>. The Default rule can be
# imported and changed, but never deleted.
terraform import uup_notification_rule.outages prj_abc123/rul_def456
```
